title: VoxCPM2 — 2B Tokenizer-Free Multilingual TTS and Voice Cloning
summary: An open-source, 2-billion parameter speech synthesis model utilizing a tokenizer-free diffusion autoregressive architecture. It enables high-fidelity zero-shot voice cloning, stylistic control via text, and generating new voices from natural language descriptions.
research_notes: Licensed under Apache-2.0; supports 30 languages and 9 Chinese dialects with real-time performance on consumer GPUs.

evolution.summary: Released as a major successor to VoxCPM 1.5, moving to a continuous-representation pipeline that produces studio-quality 48kHz audio. It introduced 'Voice Design' for creating voices from text descriptions and significantly improved speaker similarity scores over commercial competitors.
